response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remain, AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_diff FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS mean_remain FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref AS site_code, g.insurstat AS insurance_status, g.avg_remain AS avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_diff AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff, g.avg_remain / m.mean_remain AS ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_remain IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
